info.title: UnificaMemoria
info.author: desonect
info.description: Use multiple WFS USB drives simultaneously (SDUSB + USB or 2x USB).
info.details:
A 100% RAM-only Aroma (WUPS) plugin that lets you use multiple WFS USB storage devices simultaneously on Nintendo Wii U (e.g., Internal NAND + SDUSB + external USB drive, or two physical USB drives).

Features:
- Bypasses the Wii U Menu multi-USB reboot lock (hooks nn::spm::GetStorageList strictly on Wii U Menu Title IDs).
- Preserves System Settings -> Data Management so all connected storage devices remain visible.
- Adds a WUPS Config Menu (L + Down + Select -> UnificaMemoria) to choose USB 1 or USB 2 as the install target for title installers.
- Zero NAND or kernel modifications; volumes remain independent WFS drives.
